unit: Unit 1 ~ Unit 6 非谓语基础专题
summary: 动词不作谓语时的两种常见形态：to do（不定式，表目的/具体动作）和 doing（动名词，表习惯/泛指）。

rules.title: 常见接 to do 的动词
rules.detail: want, hope, decide, plan, agree, learn, would like + to do。表目的也用 to do：He got up early to catch the bus.

examples.en: I want to be a doctor in the future.
He ran fast to catch the early bus.
examples.zh: 他跑得很快以便赶上早班车。

rules.title: 常见接 doing 的动词与词组
rules.detail: enjoy, finish, practice, mind, keep + doing；be good at / be interested in / how about / thank you for + doing。

examples.en: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
He keeps practicing English every morning.
examples.zh: 他坚持每天早上练习英语。

examples.en: How about going swimming this afternoon?
examples.zh: 今天下午去游泳怎么样？

rules.title: 既可接 to do 又可接 doing，但意思不同
rules.detail: like/love/start/begin 两者均可，意思相近；但 remember to do（记得要做）≠ remember doing（记得做过）；stop to do（停下来去做另一件事）≠ stop doing（停止做某事）；forget 同理。

examples.en: Remember to close the window when you leave.
examples.zh: 离开时记得关窗（还没关）。

examples.en: The teacher stopped talking and looked at us.
examples.zh: 老师停止讲话，看着我们。

pitfalls: enjoy 后接 to do：❌ I enjoy to read. → ✓ I enjoy reading.
forget to do / doing 混淆：❌ Don't forget closing the door.（已关过才对）→ 表「别忘了关」用 Don't forget to close the door.
介词后接 to do：❌ Thank you for to help me. → ✓ Thank you for helping me.

questions.stem: My parents hope ___ a big house near the sea.
questions.explain: hope 后接 to do：hope to have。

questions.stem: The little boy is interested in ___ model planes.
questions.explain: 介词 in 后接动名词 making。

questions.stem: It's too noisy. Please stop ___ and listen to me.
questions.explain: stop doing = 停止正在做的事（别讲话了）；stop to talk 是停下来去讲话，不合语境。

questions.stem: Remember ___ the lights when you leave the classroom.
questions.explain: remember to do = 记得去做（还没做）。

questions.stem: He got up early ___ (catch) the first bus.
questions.explain: 表目的用不定式 to catch。

questions.stem: Thank you for ___ (help) me with my English.
questions.explain: 介词 for 后接动名词 helping。

questions.stem: We decided going to the museum instead of staying at home.
questions.explain: decide 后接 to do：decided to go。

questions.stem: 我的梦想是当一名老师。（翻译整句）
answer: my dream is to be a teacher.
my dream is to become a teacher.
questions.explain: 表身份、愿望用 to be a teacher。

questions.stem: 练习弹钢琴需要时间。（翻译整句，practice）
answer: practicing playing the piano takes time.
questions.explain: 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数 takes。
